page.overview:
Who is Adolf Hitler?

One of Hitler's closest associates was the Red Skull, notorious for committing acts considered terrible even by the Nazis. After the defeat of the Third Reich and Hitler's suicide, the Red Skull carried Hitler's ideals into the modern age.
